proposed_capability: Persist the verified startup bridge scope before save dispatch so a pending effect can be reconciled under its original startup identity.
player_save_control_impact: Receipt metadata only. Existing dispatch, save admission, player priority and no automatic replay continue to apply.
expected_outcome: The local launch receipt identifies the bridge process, authorized run and startup attempt before a possible startup effect and retains them after a lost acknowledgement.
negative_tests: A pending effect must not be replayed, and a receipt write failure must deny save dispatch.
rollback_path: Revert the source commits. Earlier launch receipts remain readable.
unresolved_unknowns: Local exact-build Windows Sims binding and live responder proof.
